QuestInfo.name: [Karote] Vessel of the Adversary
QuestInfo.0:
The tower's structure is still in flux, some parts rising, others collapsing. In the midst of all that, you've found the #bstatue#k from earlier.
On a possibly related note, #bNeinheart#k says he has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.2: Whatever work might have been done here, the clues are cryptic and scattered. #bNeinheart#k has quieted down, thinking everything over.
QuestInfo.1: #bNeinheart#k speculates that the work being done here involved a 'vessel of the Adversary.'
